tools.name: check_address
tools.description: Use when someone asks what applies to a rented home at a postcode in England. Returns whether a council property licence is needed for the household type, the council's licensing schemes, the planned landlord register window, flood zone and conservation area, each with its source, and councilPage, L

tools.name: search_rules
tools.description: Use for general questions about what private landlords in England must do, such as gas safety, deposits, EPC ratings, smoke alarms or notices. Searches Lettance's catalogue of rules, each cited to legislation.gov.uk or GOV.UK, and returns matching rule ids with summaries. Use get_rule for one rule's

tools.name: get_rule
tools.description: Use when you have a rule id from search_rules and need its full detail: the requirement, deadline, evidence to keep, penalty, legal basis and official guidance links. Read-only. Unknown ids return an error rather than a guess.

tools.name: council_licensing
tools.description: Use when someone asks about a council's licensing schemes in England. Returns every scheme for the council with its wards, dates, fees and council sources. Pass a slug such as 'southwark' or a name such as 'Birmingham'. Read-only. A council we have not researched yet returns researched: false with i
